Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams. Minimum Qualifications Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages. Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP). Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers. Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers. title: IT / Telecom Specialist
description: MOSTAQBAL IS HIRING | IT Officer MOSTAQBAL is currently seeking a qualified IT Officer to join our team.  Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. - 2–3 years of relevant experience in IT support, systems administration, technical troubleshooting, or related IT functions. Preferred Certifications / Courses: - Cisco (CCNA/CCENT). - Microsoft certifications. - Cybersecurity Fundamentals. - Artificial Intelligence (AI) platforms and technologies.  Technical Skills & Qualifications: - Operating Systems: Advanced proficiency in Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server. - Hardware Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose, repair, and replace components for desktop computers, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices using standard diagnostic utilities. - Networking Fundamentals: Hands-on experience managing TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, subnets, routers, switches, and firewalls. - Identity & Access Management: Experience provisioning user accounts, managing Group Policies, handling password resets, and working within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) cloud environments. - Virtualization & Cloud: Familiarity with virtual machine configuration (VMware / Hyper-V) and cloud resource administration (Microsoft Azure / AWS). - Security & Compliance: Experience configuring endpoint antivirus, enforcing firewall rules, managing data backups, and deploying system security patches. - AI Platforms: Working knowledge and familiarity with modern AI platforms and tools.
